name: Mogaran

notes.saves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

items.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic
Crystal Implant
items.text: The wolf-head shaped crystal implanted in Mogaran's brow pulses with shadowy energy at the start of each of his turns. Any PC who's legendary in Arcana, Occultism, or Religion and sees this can attempt a DC 36 check using one of those skills (DC 36 Arcana check, DC 36 Occultism check, or DC 36 Religion check); on a success, they realize the crystal is manipulating Mogaran's actions in some way. If the crystal is destroyed or deactivated, Mogaran regains control of his actions. The crystal functions as a 19th-level magic item for the purposes of dispel magic, but it can also be destroyed by specifically targeting it (AC 40; Hardness 20; HP 90). Alternately, a character can pry the crystal from Mogaran's brow with a successful DC 36 Athletics check check, which takes an Interact action, but only if Mogaran is Immobilized.

items.name: Frightful Presence
items.text:
60 feet. DC 35 Will save

This aura is suppressed as long as Mogaran's crystal implant is functioning.

---

items.name: Restoration Vulnerability
items.text: Mogaran is repulsed by the restoration of souls. He takes 3d10+10 mental damage the first time each round a creature within 100 feet of him is restored to life or loses the Doomed condition.

items.name: Smoking Wound
items.text: A creature damaged by Mogaran's jaws is Sickened 1 from the rank smell of vapors from the wound.

items.name: Soulfire Breath
items.text: Mogaran exhales ghostly green fire in a 60-foot cone. Living creatures in the area take 18d6 void damage (DC 38 basic Reflex save save). A good creature that fails this save becomes Stupefied 2 for 1 minute (Stupefied 4 on a critical failure). A creature slain by Soulfire Breath can't be resurrected except by powerful magic such as a wish spell. Mogaran can't use Soulfire Breath again for 1d4 rounds.

items.name: Soulfire Inhalation
items.text:
Requirements Mogaran's last action was Soulfire Breath

---

Effect Mogaran inhales and regains 10 healing Hit Points for each creature damaged by his Soulfire Breath. Any excess healing is gained as temporary Hit Points, which remain for 1 minute.

items.name: Stunning Tail
items.text: If Mogaran critically hits with his tail Strike, the target must succeed at a DC 38 Fortitude save save or be Stunned for 1 round (1d4 rounds on a critical failure).

items.name: Trample
items.text:
Large or smaller, claw, DC 38 basic Reflex save
